reviewItem.question: For "The IP addresses on which to expose NodePort services can now be configured with `nodePort.addresses`. Prior to this, Cilium only exposed NodePort services on…", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

proposed.statement: The Helm value `nodePort.addresses` was added to configure which IP addresses expose NodePort services; previously Cilium used only the first suitable IPv4 and IPv6 address per device.
